All you can drink

From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Black Wagyu! Miraisaka Special Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Double Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Double Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Reserve by three days in advance during the period to enjoy double the amount of Wagyu in our Sukiyaki! This course features a luxurious Sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from Seiryu Wakadori, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish, making it perfect for special moments with your loved ones. You can also change the Sukiyaki to a Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Please indicate any changes in the remarks section. If no changes are noted, we will serve the "Wagyu Sukiyaki."

Indulge in a course featuring luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu beef, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from fresh river chicken, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish. This course is perfect for cherishing moments with your loved ones. You can also opt to change the sukiyaki to a seafood hot pot with Japanese pufferfish. If you wish to make this change, please indicate it in the remarks section. If no request is made, we will serve the "Wagyu Beef Sukiyaki."

Reserve by three days in advance during the promotional period to enjoy double the Omi beef in our sukiyaki! Indulge in a luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with specially selected Omi beef, or choose our Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. This course is perfect for creating cherished moments with your loved ones. If you have any specific requests for changes, please note them in the remarks section. From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Black Wagyu! Miraisaka Special Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Double Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Double Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Reserve by three days in advance during the period to enjoy double the amount of Wagyu in our Sukiyaki! This course features a luxurious Sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from Seiryu Wakadori, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish, making it perfect for special moments with your loved ones. You can also change the Sukiyaki to a Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Please indicate any changes in the remarks section. If no changes are noted, we will serve the "Wagyu Sukiyaki."

Miraisaka Special Course with Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Indulge in a course featuring luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu beef, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from fresh river chicken, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish. This course is perfect for cherishing moments with your loved ones. You can also opt to change the sukiyaki to a seafood hot pot with Japanese pufferfish. If you wish to make this change, please indicate it in the remarks section. If no request is made, we will serve the "Wagyu Beef Sukiyaki."

From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Omi Beef! Gourmet Feast Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 6000 - A Satisfying Luxurious Banquet! Choose Between 'Sukiyaki of Omi Beef' or 'Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Reserve by three days in advance during the promotional period to enjoy double the Omi beef in our sukiyaki! Indulge in a luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with specially selected Omi beef, or choose our Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Additionally, you can savor Omi beef eel rolls and domestic Japanese pufferfish kara-age, all while enjoying a 2.5-hour all-you-can-drink option. This course is perfect for creating cherished moments with your loved ones. If you have any specific requests for changes, please note them in the remarks section. If no requests are made, we will serve the "Omi Beef Sukiyaki."

From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Black Wagyu! Miraisaka Special Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Double Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Double Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Reserve by three days in advance during the period to enjoy double the amount of Wagyu in our Sukiyaki! This course features a luxurious Sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from Seiryu Wakadori, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish, making it perfect for special moments with your loved ones. You can also change the Sukiyaki to a Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Please indicate any changes in the remarks section. If no changes are noted, we will serve the "Wagyu Sukiyaki."

Indulge in a course featuring luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu beef, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from fresh river chicken, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish. This course is perfect for cherishing moments with your loved ones. You can also opt to change the sukiyaki to a seafood hot pot with Japanese pufferfish. If you wish to make this change, please indicate it in the remarks section. If no request is made, we will serve the "Wagyu Beef Sukiyaki."

Reserve by three days in advance during the promotional period to enjoy double the Omi beef in our sukiyaki! Indulge in a luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with specially selected Omi beef, or choose our Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Additionally, you can savor Omi beef eel rolls and domestic Japanese pufferfish kara-age, all while enjoying a 2.5-hour all-you-can-drink option. This course is perfect for creating cherished moments with your loved ones. If you have any specific requests for changes, please note them in the remarks section. All you can drink

From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Black Wagyu! Miraisaka Special Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Double Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Double Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Reserve by three days in advance during the period to enjoy double the amount of Wagyu in our Sukiyaki! This course features a luxurious Sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from Seiryu Wakadori, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish, making it perfect for special moments with your loved ones. You can also change the Sukiyaki to a Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Please indicate any changes in the remarks section. If no changes are noted, we will serve the "Wagyu Sukiyaki."

Miraisaka Special Course with Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Indulge in a course featuring luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu beef, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from fresh river chicken, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish. This course is perfect for cherishing moments with your loved ones. You can also opt to change the sukiyaki to a seafood hot pot with Japanese pufferfish. If you wish to make this change, please indicate it in the remarks section. If no request is made, we will serve the "Wagyu Beef Sukiyaki."

From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Omi Beef! Gourmet Feast Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 6000 - A Satisfying Luxurious Banquet! Choose Between 'Sukiyaki of Omi Beef' or 'Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Reserve by three days in advance during the promotional period to enjoy double the Omi beef in our sukiyaki! Indulge in a luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with specially selected Omi beef, or choose our Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Additionally, you can savor Omi beef eel rolls and domestic Japanese pufferfish kara-age, all while enjoying a 2.5-hour all-you-can-drink option. This course is perfect for creating cherished moments with your loved ones. If you have any specific requests for changes, please note them in the remarks section. If no requests are made, we will serve the "Omi Beef Sukiyaki."

From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Black Wagyu! Miraisaka Special Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Double Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Double Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Reserve by three days in advance during the period to enjoy double the amount of Wagyu in our Sukiyaki! This course features a luxurious Sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from Seiryu Wakadori, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish, making it perfect for special moments with your loved ones. You can also change the Sukiyaki to a Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Please indicate any changes in the remarks section. If no changes are noted, we will serve the "Wagyu Sukiyaki."

Miraisaka Special Course with Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Indulge in a course featuring luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu beef, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from fresh river chicken, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish. This course is perfect for cherishing moments with your loved ones. You can also opt to change the sukiyaki to a seafood hot pot with Japanese pufferfish. If you wish to make this change, please indicate it in the remarks section. If no request is made, we will serve the "Wagyu Beef Sukiyaki."

Reserve by three days in advance during the promotional period to enjoy double the Omi beef in our sukiyaki! Indulge in a luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with specially selected Omi beef, or choose our Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Additionally, you can savor Omi beef eel rolls and domestic Japanese pufferfish kara-age, all while enjoying a 2.5-hour all-you-can-drink option. This course is perfect for creating cherished moments with your loved ones. If you have any specific requests for changes, please note them in the remarks section.
